rotation: Same three sessions fixed to Tue / Wed / Fri so load progression stays readable week to week.
note: Fourth 0 of 3 week. Nothing logged since 09-16, twenty-five days. Last week's lever was the day, Monday to Tuesday, and it got one week with almost no data behind it: no health file exists for Tue 10-06 or Fri 10-09 at all, so a session that happened and went unlogged is indistinguishable from a skip. The schedule holds for that reason, not because it is working yet. The lever this week is the floor. Each session now names one anchor lift, and that lift alone counts as the session: open the page, log one exercise, done, streak intact. Everything after the anchor is a bonus, not a requirement. Exercise selection is otherwise unchanged except that Seated cable row comes off Wednesday, which drops the longest day from four working lifts to three. It had been programmed four weeks running with zero history, and Wednesday needed to be the shortest it has ever been rather than the longest. The horizontal pull moves to Friday's single-arm cable row. Lat pulldown, the one favorited lift, stays where it does the most good: the anchor of the easiest session in the week. Loads carry forward unchanged for the fourth time, because nothing was logged to progress against. Straight sets, no supersets. A day that genuinely did not happen is worth logging as a skip, empty exercises and feel 'skipped', so the calendar stops guessing.

progression.rule: Double progression driven by the average RPE of the logged sets, matching the suggester already running in workout.html.
table: avg RPE 7.0 or below: add one load_step from assets/exercises.js.
avg RPE 7.1 to 8.0: hold the load and add a rep, unless every set was already at the same load and at the top of the prescribed rep range, which earns the load step instead.
avg RPE 8.1 to 9.0: repeat the same load and clean up execution.
avg RPE above 9.0: hold, or back off five percent.
Bodyweight and timed work progresses on reps or seconds, never load.
Dumbbell loads are per hand, so one load_step of 5 is one size up on one bell.
Any of the above is overridden when the session note reports pain or a form breakdown. Load does not advance on a pattern he cannot yet brace.
progression.note: Fourth week with nothing to progress against, so every load carries forward. Prescriptions remain keyed to the last session each exercise actually appeared in: 09-16 for the Wednesday lifts, 09-11 for the Friday lifts, 09-09 for the lat pulldown. The 09-16 lat pulldown numbers are ignored on purpose, because that was the rotating-handle substitute machine he will not use again. Three steps are still owed and still unearned until a session lands: incline dumbbell press to 35 per hand, triceps pushdown 12 reps across at 35, walking lunge three full sets at 30 per hand. workout.html does not know the rep-range ceiling, so its on-page suggestion can read 'chase a rep' where the program names a heavier load. The program's named load wins.

sessions.title: Pull & Legs
sessions.focus: Anchor is the lat pulldown. Three sets of your favorite lift is the whole session; the leg press is a bonus if you are still there. Bolted onto the Tuesday walk.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: The anchor. Standard wide bar, not the rotating-handle machine. 100 for 10 across on 09-09, so hold 100 and chase 12 before the load moves.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Bonus. Still no history after four weeks of carrying it. Pick a load you can finish ten clean reps with and write the number down. Stop before your hips curl off the pad.

sessions.title: Press, Hinge & Brace
sessions.focus: Anchor is the overhead press, the only lift in the week with a clean recent number. Hip thrust and bird dog are the glute and anti-lordosis work behind it. Three lifts, the shortest Wednesday yet.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.cue: The anchor, and it leads now instead of following the hinge. 30 per hand, same as 09-16, where the third set dropped to 25 at RPE 9. Three clean sets at 30 is the whole job. Per hand, not the pair.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Programmed four weeks running and never run. Stop at a straight line from knee to shoulder, ribs down. Record the load so this slot finally has a history.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Easier to hold a flat back than the dead bug, which fell apart by set three on 09-16. Hips square, slow beats far. Finish with the couch stretch and log it as a cool-down, because no hip flexor work has shown up in any session yet.

sessions.title: Chest, Single-leg & Row
sessions.focus: Anchor is the incline press, which is owed a load step from 09-11. Lunge and row after it if the day has room. About twenty minutes full out.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: The anchor, and it leads the day now. 30 per hand for 10 across at Hard on 09-11 earned the step and it is still owed four weeks later. Go to 35 per hand, bench at 30 degrees.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: 30 per hand on all three sets. On 09-11 set one was 20, so the load step still has not been earned. Per hand.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: The week's only horizontal pull now that Wednesday dropped the cable row. One arm at a time, single handle. You ran it two-handed on 09-11 and the load went unrecorded. Let the shoulder blade travel forward, then pull, and write the number down.

optional_addins.title: Hips & Posture
optional_addins.focus: Direct work on the lordosis: lengthen the hip flexors, get the glutes doing their job, brace without arching. The dead bug lost its brace on 09-16, and this is why.
optional_addins.when: Any off day, Monday included now that it is free. 10 minutes. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That tuck is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: If the low back lifts, keep your heels sliding on the floor instead of hovering. Range is negotiable, the flat back is not.

optional_addins.title: Arms, Shoulders & Calves
optional_addins.focus: Low-stakes volume for arms, delts and calves. Nothing here taxes recovery, so skip it guilt-free. This is where the triceps pushdown and reverse pec deck live, off the critical path.
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day, or bolted onto the end of any session that felt short. 20 minutes.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Parked at 35 for two sessions running. Stay at 35 and get 12 on all three sets, then it moves to 40.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: The rear-delt slot. Elbows soft, light enough that nothing leans back.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top, and record the load.
